The California Wealth Tax is a precursor to the 2028 primary.

Newsom is fighting to keep a Dem Party that caters to billionaires, because he needs them to fund his campaign.

Ro Khanna has backed the wealth tax because he wants a Dem Party that is free to tackle the oligarchy. That led the billionaires to fund a primary challenge against him (which he beat).

Northern LA County: temperatures will be in the 90s if not higher for the weekend and most of the next week.  Hydrate, make sure kids, elders and pets are okay, and try to stay cool!

You can find free cooling centers by calling 211 or checking the Ready LA County Heat Program. 

Get more info here:
